variables.name: lazyDirectBuffer
variables.comment:
* A lazy-created direct buffer used as a bridge between heap buffers provided by the
     * application and JNI. This avoids the overhead of calling JNI with heap buffers.
     * Used only when no {@link #bufferAllocator} has been provided.

variables.comment: * Hostname used with the TLS extension SNI hostname.

variables.comment: * Wrapper around the underlying SSL object.

variables.comment: * A snapshot of the active session when the engine was closed.

variables.name: externalSession
variables.comment: * The session object exposed externally from this class.

variables.name: channelIdPrivateKey
variables.comment:
* Private key for the TLS Channel ID extension. This field is client-side only. Set during
     * startHandshake.

methods.comment:
* Enables/disables TLS Channel ID for this server engine. * *

This method needs to be invoked before the handshake starts. * * @throws IllegalStateException if this is a client engine or if the handshake has already * started.

methods.name: byte[] getChannelId() throws SSLException
methods.comment:
* Gets the TLS Channel ID for this server engine. Channel ID is only available once the
     * handshake completes.
     *
     * @return channel ID or {@code null} if not available.
     *
     * @throws IllegalStateException if this is a client engine or if the handshake has not yet
     * completed.
     * @throws SSLException if channel ID is available but could not be obtained.

methods.name: void setChannelIdPrivateKey(PrivateKey privateKey)
methods.comment:
* Sets the {@link PrivateKey} to be used for TLS Channel ID by this client engine. * *

This method needs to be invoked before the handshake starts. * * @param privateKey private key (enables TLS Channel ID) or {@code null} for no key (disables * TLS Channel ID). The private key must be an Elliptic Curve (EC) key based on the NIST * P-256 curve (aka SECG secp256r1 or ANSI X9.62 prime256v1). * * @throws IllegalStateException if this is a server engine or if the handshake has already * started.
